title: Qullan Uñnaqan Yant’äwipa
intro: Mä letrerojj chhaqat mä markaruw apayasïna. Suma jakawi taypinxa mä iwxt’awiw purinitayna —mä muspharkañ lurataw jupamp chikt’ata, ukax iyawsäwipan qhipa yant’äwiparuw tukuñapäna. Ukham jaysapjjäna ukhajja, wiñayatakiw destinopajj sellañapäna. ¿Khitis uka ewjjtʼa yatiyäna ukat khitinakatï jan iyawsapkäna ukanakajj kunas pasäna uk yatjjatasmati?
clues: Mä jach’a lurawiwa qullut mistuwayxi, Tatitusan mä chimpupawa aka markatakixa.
Nayax jupanakarux akham sasaw sista: ‘Akax mä camello warmiwa, Allahankiwa, ukhamax jaytapxam Allahan uraqipat manq’añapataki ukat jan jan walinak llamkt’apxamti’.
Ukampis jaqinakax Tatitupan kamachipar jan yäqasaw camellojarux ch'akhanak ch'ankhachapxäna.
Nayajj Tatituman mä yatiyirikïtwa, chekampi khitanitätwa —nayajj confiykañ profeta, sirviri jaqëtwa.
As for the wrongdoers, our Lord struck them with a thunderous sound, and they became motionless in their homes.

trial.answer: Uka camellox Diosan chimpupjama ukat yant’äwipjamaw khithatäna

outcome.answer: A thunderous sound struck them motionless

arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verse: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen. (54:31)
